item.title: Saturday, November 28
item.description: [Higher-quality voice test] We begin in the Gulf of Oman, where the U.S. military has struck and disabled a commercial vessel that was trying to run the American naval blockade of Iran.

item.title: Friday, November 27

item.title: Wednesday, November 25
item.description: The story every paper is leading with is the strange and fast-moving saga at Nvidia, and it is tangled up with a market that is wobbling on the eve of Thanksgiving.

item.title: Tuesday, November 24
item.description: The story everywhere this morning is Nvidia. Eleven days after he resigned over revelations of two extramarital affairs, Jensen Huang has been reinstated as chief executive.
